remarks: YOU CAN HAVE IT ALL!  Village Colonial.  Meticulously maintained throughout!  Featuring an absolutely beautiful formal living and dining areas with a gas fireplace. Comfortable family room. Back, outdoor egress through the glass patio doors to the spacious private concrete patio; ideal for entertaining. Custom, fully equipped kitchen with many quality cabinets and built-ins. Breakfast bar.  First floor laundry, bedroom, and bathroom. Primary bedroom with ensuite bathroom.  Four spacious bedrooms with closets. 2 1/2 baths. Finished basement with rec. room. Attached, two car, finished garage. Storage building with power. Park like setting with a partially fenced back yard. One acre. Close to SUNY Fredonia, shopping, Village amenities, parks, Lake Erie,... Interior photos coming soon!  Exceptional home and property!  Make it yours!
